model.name: diagram.addToEmptyDiagram
model.description: R33.6.1 (Tron item-1 bug, HIGHEST PRI): adding an element to a NEW/EMPTY diagram must add + persist the box - drop-to-add was broken specifically for empty diagrams. FIX (correct-by-construction 1-liner, a7ae1872d v0.8.21): RbDiagramDetail stripRef now strips the 'diagram:' prefix so a NEW/empty diagram's ref resolves and addView writes the view. RIDES the existing R32.11 add path (reuse Class RbDiagramDetail 039ec367 + Method addView 70be1605 + Impl 4e74dfee) - NO new decl (bug fix in existing addView), NO fabricated Impl. Tap trigger = onSelectionChanged (UC diagram.tapToAdd 87d3d693). Distinct-intent from R32.11 diagram.addView (general add) - this is the EMPTY-diagram case.
